title: hi guys, single dad of 6, lost my job 45 years ago and just launched my dream game on steam!
author: Morpegom
selftext:
i know the game isn't perfect yet, and i still have a lot to learn, but i really put my heart into making this since I started 7 years ago.

this is my first project, a reflection of everything that I really like and love, and every bit of feedback means a lot to me. i'm just one person trying to make something fun, so please be kind. i'll keep improving it and doing my best. thank you to everyone who takes the time to play it and im really proud of what Im making

[add to your wishlist!](https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ?is=qkEp1sG2ILzLGsNU)

AI Disclosure: minor assets where created with AI and as you can see in the image they were edited, reviewed, estilezed, circumsized, showered, burned and cherry picked by a solo developer father of 7 (just discovered im pregnant of one)
